description: This file contains test utilities, mock classes, and test implementations related to the reporting system in Chromium, including test versions of reporting uploader, delegate, context, and service, as well as helper functions for testing reporting endpoints and reports.

classes.name: TestReportingUploader
classes.description: A test implementation of ReportingUploader that holds uploads for examination and completion.

classes.name: TestReportingDelegate
classes.description: A test implementation of ReportingDelegate that allows permission control and uses real JSON parsing.

classes.name: TestReportingContext
classes.description: A test implementation of ReportingContext using test clocks, timers, and uploader.

classes.name: ReportingTestBase
classes.description: A base class providing a test reporting context and helper functions for testing reporting features.

classes.name: TestReportingService
classes.description: A test implementation of ReportingService that records reports and manages test policies.

methods.name: UsePolicy
methods.description: Sets the reporting policy for the test context.

methods.name: UseStore
methods.description: Sets the persistent reporting store for the test context.

methods.name: FindEndpointInCache
methods.description: Finds a specific reporting endpoint in the cache.

methods.name: SetEndpointInCache
methods.description: Sets a reporting endpoint in the cache with specified properties.

methods.name: SetV1EndpointInCache
methods.description: Sets an origin-specific endpoint in the cache.

methods.name: EndpointExistsInCache
methods.description: Checks if a specific endpoint exists in the cache.

methods.name: GetEndpointStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for a specific endpoint.

methods.name: EndpointGroupExistsInCache
methods.description: Checks if an endpoint group with specific properties exists.

methods.name: ClientExistsInCacheForOrigin
methods.description: Checks if a client for a given origin exists in the cache.

methods.name: MakeURL
methods.description: Creates a unique URL based on an index.

methods.name: SimulateRestart
methods.description: Simulates an embedder restart, advancing clocks.

methods.name: QueueReport
methods.description: Queues a report for sending.

methods.name: ProcessReportToHeader
methods.description: Processes a report to a header.

methods.name: RemoveBrowsingData
methods.description: Removes specific browsing data.

methods.name: RemoveAllBrowsingData
methods.description: Removes all browsing data.

methods.name: GetPolicy
methods.description: Returns the current reporting policy.

methods.name: GetReports
methods.description: Returns the list of reports.

methods.name: GetV1ReportingEndpointsByOrigin
methods.description: Returns reporting endpoints grouped by origin.

methods.name: AddReportingCacheObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer to the reporting cache.

methods.name: RemoveReportingCacheObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer from the reporting cache.
